'''2006 World Championship Day 2/3 Brian Rippetoe DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brian Rippetoe]] at [[2006 World Championship]] (Day 2/3); the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Brian "X-Zipher" Rippetoe (2006-11-14).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35803 Rip's Day 2/3 CCT]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20071109213014/http://decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=35803 Internet Archive]</ref>

'''Note:''' Shield slot 10 differs by day: Tractor Beam (Day 2) vs Restraining Bolt (Day 3); both listed.<ref name="src" />
